name: How do I choose the right contractor for my garage addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my garage addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor is crucial for a successful garage addition. Look for licensed, bonded, and insured general contractors with experience in similar projects in your area. Check their references, review their portfolio, and read customer testimonials. Ensure they provide a detailed, transparent proposal outlining costs, timelines, and materials. Communication style, reliability, and their ability to navigate local regulations are also important factors. A good contractor will help you understand each step of the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, experienced, and insured contractor with good references and a clear proposal. Evaluate their communication, reliability, and local expertise.
